subject: Post-call: procurement path & marketplace interest for NovaHealth
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@novahealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@novahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: procurement path & marketplace interest for NovaHealth

Alex — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary:
- Use case: internal research platform + customer-facing summarization. Pilot scope: 3 teams, ~10k tokens/day.
- Non-negotiables called out: SOC 2 attestation, audit logs, data retention policy (90d), and options for VPC/private deployment later.

Procurement & buying path (items we need to confirm):
1) Commercial route: Do you prefer AWS Marketplace (Consolidated bill) for speed or a direct PO/invoice (Net 30) for enterprise purchase?
2) Paper process: If PO, will you require a signature SOW and standard vendor paperwork (W-9, COI, SOC2)?
3) Timeline: target procurement sign-off window (pilot start) — are you aiming for < 30 days or a longer procurement cycle?

Attachments: Redwood-Procurement-Checklist.xlsx (attached) — a short checklist of items procurement usually asks for.

Next steps I propose: 
- You confirm preferred buying route (Marketplace vs PO) and introduce your procurement lead (Lydia?) if PO.
- I’ll put together a one-page SOW + sample PO language and return by EOD tomorrow.
- If Marketplace preferred for pilot, we can get you a test listing and invoice flow to start in 1–2 business days.

Thanks — keen to keep momentum.

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Redwood-Procurement-Checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)
From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@novahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@novahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement path & marketplace interest for NovaHealth

Ben — appreciate the follow-up and checklist, that’s helpful. Quick answers from procurement side: 

- For the pilot (small scale), our product teams prefer AWS Marketplace where possible — it minimizes internal PO overhead and gets teams running quickly.
- For the enterprise contract (after pilot) procurement will require PO/invoice with our standard terms (Net 30) + SOW. We will also need sample PO language and confirmation that Redwood can accept our standard SOC2 addendum language.
- Timeline: pilot needs to start by mid-October; procurement is open to accelerated review but will want the SOW and vendor packet to review by next week.

Looping Lydia (procurement lead) — Lydia, can you confirm any internal vendor onboarding docs you need? Also attaching a very short vendor questionnaire procurement sent us earlier (vendor-questions.pdf).

Thanks,
Alex
Director, Product Operations | NovaHealth
alex.taylor@novahealth.com | +1 202-555-0112

Attachment: vendor-questions.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: procurement path & marketplace interest for NovaHealth

Ben / Marissa — picking this up. Short internal plan to move quickly: 

1) Dual-track approach (recommended):
   - Track A (fast): AWS Marketplace for pilot to unblock product teams ASAP. Marketplace listing + consolidated billing should remove the need for a PO for the pilot.
   - Track B (enterprise): Prepare SOW + sample PO language + vendor packet so procurement can start legal/review in parallel. Expect 2–4 week review for larger terms.

2) Ask engineering for a short note on data handling (SOC2 scope, logs location, retention). Marissa — can you draft a 1-paragraph assurance we can share with procurement (SOC2 type, evidence location, contact for audit requests)?

3) Finance ops: reach out to payment ops to confirm we can accept NovaHealth PO with Net 30 and flag for revenue recognition team. Ben — can you confirm if Finance needs any specific wording for PO acceptance?

4) SOW: I’ll sketch a 1-page SOW template (pilot scope, timeline, pilot pricing, termination) and share to this thread by EOD tomorrow so Ben can send to Alex. We should also include acceptance criteria and migration/exit terms.

Internal attachments: none.

Karthik
Director, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference

Thanks Alex / Lydia — looping in our suggested next steps and attaching a one-page SOW draft for pilot (SOW_draft.pdf).

Quick answers to Lydia’s likely asks:
- Vendor packet: we can provide W-9, SOC 2 summary, standard COI. SOC2 report can be shared under NDA — Marissa will coordinate delivery.
- PO language: we accept standard Net 30 POs; for invoicing please have PO reference Deal ID D-98721 and bill to Redwood Inference, 1200 Market St, San Francisco, CA.

Proposed immediate plan:
- If you want Marketplace start: product teams can spin up access this week. We’ll prepare an invoice path if necessary.
- If you want to go PO route now: Lydia, please share vendor onboarding doc and we’ll return completed packet + SOW (attached) for legal review.

Action items:
- Alex / Lydia: confirm whether pilot should go through AWS Marketplace or we should start PO intake.
- Lydia: if PO, please share onboarding checklist and preferred PO wording (or we can provide sample).
- Marissa: please send SOC2 summary and vendor packet link to Lydia when ready.
